name: Ripio wBRL
oneLiner: WBRL is Ripio's wrapped Brazilian real stablecoin targeting 1 WBRL = 1 BRL, backed by BRL cash and local-currency instruments under Ripio's wFIAT issuance.
collateral: Brazilian-real fiat cash deposited in a Brazilian bank account, backing Ripio wBRL one-to-one against the Brazilian real per Ripio's wFIAT token certifications
pegMechanism: WBRL is issued and managed by Ripio against local fiat reserves, but ordinary holders do not have a documented direct redemption right with the issuer. Exits depend on secondary-market liquidity, Ripio on/off-ramp flows, or issuer-managed market operations.

mintAuthority.summary: WBRL is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. All chains use the same contract address with identical role holders: EOA 0x466c02e2 (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER), Safe 0x2b839174 (4/7, DEFAULT_ADMIN), and two AccessControl minter-router contracts whose own admins are the same EOA and Safe.

controls.label: Ripio shared WBRL admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) both returned true. eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Same role confirmed via hasRole on Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at same block range.

controls.label: Ripio WBRL Safe multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) returned true. getOwners() returned 7 owners; getThreshold() returned 4. getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules). slot0 masterCopy = 0x41675c...61a (Safe v1.4.1 singleton). fallbackHandler = 0xfd0732...ec99 (standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler). getGuard() reverted (no guard).

controls.label: Ripio WBRL Ethereum minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WBRL token. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe). Not deployed on other chains (eth_getCode = 0x on Base).

controls.label: Ripio WBRL cross-chain minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WBRL token on Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe).

review.evidence: All mint-capable role holders verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at block 25295015. EOA 0x466c02e2 confirmed via eth_getCode. Safe 0x2b839174 confirmed as 4/7 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules or guard. Minter-router contracts 0xd168cfbb and 0x46167cb0 confirmed as AccessControl contracts whose admins are the same EOA and Safe.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ripio wBRL is centrally issued across multiple EVM chains; the public source confirms issuer-managed wFIAT mechanics but does not prove a holder-level blacklist path.

reserveReview.rationale: The March 31, 2026 certification reconciles 719,448 outstanding wBRL across six chains and R$809,597.28 of collateral to a Brazilian bank statement, then certifies that all outstanding tokens are backed by Brazilian reais at a financial institution in Brazil. The engagement is expressly a certification, not an audit or review, and the bank and account terms are not disclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent public accountant certification of the wBRL collateral as of March 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class is unclassified; the Brazilian financial institution, account type, and withdrawal liquidity are undisclosed.
